CustomField.label: VIP
CustomField.description: ★R8 SEIM_INVITEE.IS_VIP. On the invitee, not the attendee, and that placement is the whole content of the decision: someone is a VIP *at this event* — a keynote speaker at one symposium is an ordinary guest at the next. Marking it person-level would make the flag follow them everywhere and quietly become meaningless. Nothing in the workflow reads it yet; it is a fact for the AM running the room.
